failure_mode: A query by meaning gives items that do not relate to the subject, or does not give items that do.
cause: A query by meaning has no correct answer that a person can state in advance. It has a better answer and a worse one.
effect: An agent reasons over the wrong material and answers with confidence. The reader cannot see which items the agent did not get.
detection: Nobody detects it. The answer is well formed and the agent does not know what it missed.

failure_mode: The system reports a write as accepted and then does not hold the item.
cause: The system reports the write before the item is durable, and the host stops.
effect: Data that Ingestion acquired is in no part of the platform. Ingestion reports a source that is healthy, because from outside the delivery succeeded.
detection: A comparison of what a writer sent with what the system holds.

failure_mode: Data that the user removed stays reachable.
cause: Removal takes the current value of an item and leaves the values that the item held before.
effect: The user believes that the data is gone. REQ-PL-026 is a statement that the platform does not keep, and the user cannot reverse the belief.
detection: A query for the removed data after the removal.

failure_mode: The system cannot restore life state from the copy away from the host.
cause: Nobody restored from the copy. The form of the copy changed, or the copy holds a state that is not consistent.
effect: Life state is lost. REQ-PL-022 fails at the one moment where it is needed.
detection: A restoration that the platform performs and reports.

failure_mode: The system refuses a write and reports nothing.
cause: REQ-ST-002 and REQ-ST-003 state a refusal and state no report.
effect: The writer believes that it delivered. Ingestion reports a healthy source, and the item is in no part of the platform.
detection: A comparison of what a writer sent with what the system holds.

failure_mode: A derived value stays after the system removes the data that the derivation used.
cause: Removal acts on the item and does not act on a derivation that used the item.
effect: The platform holds an assertion that it cannot explain, and REQ-PL-015 cannot be met for that assertion.
detection: A comparison of the inputs of each derived value with the items that the system holds.

failure_mode: The system gives a value that is not the most recent observation of an item.
cause: The system orders values by the time that it received them, and a source delivers an older observation later.
effect: An agent acts on a value that is not current. The user states that this condition stops the use of the system.

failure_mode: The system serves a part of life state that the position of the caller does not admit.
cause: The declaration of the position changed and the system used an earlier copy of it.
effect: An agent reads a domain that is not its own, and the data appears in its output. This is the path in RSK-PL-005 that stays inside the platform.
detection: A read that the system refuses, compared with the declaration.

failure_mode: The system accepts a write to a part of life state that the position of the writer does not admit.
cause: The declaration of the position changed and the system used an earlier copy of it.
effect: An agent asserts in a domain that is not its own. The assertion carries an origin that makes it look correct.
detection: A write that the system refuses, compared with the declaration.

failure_mode: The system matches an item that arrives against an item that it holds, and the two are not the same item.
cause: Two items carry one identifier, or the system matches on a value that the source rewrites.
effect: One item replaces another. The item that is replaced is lost and nothing reports the loss.
detection: A test of the identifier before the system matches.

failure_mode: A query does not complete in the time that a caller needs.
cause: Life state grows and nothing expires (DEC-021). The host has two processors.
effect: An exchange with the user stops being usable, and an agent that waits holds work that does not move.
detection: The system reports the time that it takes to answer.
